NGA.note: INEC's removal of AI-generated photos is a register clean-up; no AI rule or designated AI authority is stated.
INEC's ABIS is biometric matching, not stated as an AI system in use; the chairman's support for AI is a statement of intent.
No AI tool in a sector's public system is stated.
No locally built AI model, dataset or computing is stated.

facts.fact: Nigeria's electoral commission INEC says it screened its voter register with its Automated Biometric Identification System and removed more than 1.6 million invalid records ahead of the 2027 elections.
INEC says the preliminary voter register was physically displayed at Registration Areas nationwide from 9 to 15 October 2026 and published online on 26 October 2026.

NGA.note: The biometric system described is the voter register's, not the national ID's.
